title: Discovery of the oncogenic MDM2, a direct binding target of berberine and a potential therapeutic, in multiple myeloma.
authors: Li, Chuting; Su, Ru; Wang, Xiuyuan; Huang, Guiping; Liu, Yanjun; Yang, Juhua; Yin, Zhao; Gu, Chunming; Fei, Jia
one_liner_zh: 该文研究小檗碱与MDM2蛋白的直接结合及抗骨髓瘤机制，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Recent studies have suggested the potency of berberine (BBR) for multiple cancer treatments, including multiple myeloma (MM). However, the direct target and underlying mechanism of BBR remain largely understood in MM. Here, we demonstrated that BBR inhibited cell proliferation and acted synergistically with bortezomib in MM.1S cells. BBR treatment induced MM cell cycle arrest by downregulating several cell cycle-related proteins. Murine double minute 2 (MDM2) as a BBR-binding protein was identified by surface plasmon resonance image (SPRi) analysis and molecular docking. Overexpression of MDM2 is associated with MM progression and a poor prognosis. Knockdown MDM2 by siRNA transfection can repress MM malignant progression and attenuate the BBR sensitivity to MM.1S cells. BBR treatment induced the degradation of MDM2 through the ubiquitin-proteasome system and reactivated P53/P21 in MM cells. Overall, our data has illustrated that MDM2, as a binding protein of BBR for the first time, may serve as a potential therapeutic option for MM.
abstract_zh: 近期研究提示小檗碱（berberine, BBR）在多种癌症治疗中具有潜力，包括多发性骨髓瘤（multiple myeloma, MM）。然而，BBR在MM中的直接靶点及其潜在机制仍大部分未被阐明。在此，我们证明BBR抑制细胞增殖，并与硼替佐米（bortezomib）在MM.1S细胞中协同作用。BBR处理通过下调多种细胞周期相关蛋白诱导MM细胞周期阻滞。通过表面等离子体共振成像（surface plasmon resonance image, SPRi）分析和分子对接，鉴定出鼠双微体2（murine double minute 2, MDM2）为BBR结合蛋白。MDM2的过表达与MM进展及不良预后相关。通过siRNA转染敲低MDM2可抑制MM恶性进展，并减弱MM.1S细胞对BBR的敏感性。BBR处理通过泛素-蛋白酶体系统诱导MDM2降解，并重新激活MM细胞中的P53/P21。总体而言，我们的数据首次阐明MDM2作为BBR的结合蛋白，可能成为MM的潜在治疗靶点。
